questions.question: The volume of a right circular cone is 1078 cm³. Find the total surface area of the cone if its height is 21 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Volume** V = (1/3) × π × r² × h ⇒ 1078 = (1/3) × (22/7) × r² × 21

r² = 1078 ÷ 22 = 49 ⇒ **Radius (r)** = 7 cm

**Slant height (l)** = √(h² + r²) = √(21² + 7²) = √(441 + 49) = √490 = 7√10 cm

**TSA** = πr(r + l) = (22/7) × 7 × (7 + 7√10) = 22 × 7(1 + √10) = 154(1 + √10) cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 154(1 + √10) cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Volume of cone = 1078 cm³, Height (h) = 21 cm, π = 22/7

**Formula Used:** Volume = (1/3)πr²h, Total Surface Area (TSA) = πr(r + l), Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab7d0f21b2792069a8699b3410713418ca28e3b628b5c7c31006cc966bf5b4e0.png] 

⇒ 1078 = (1/3) × (22/7) × r² × 21

⇒ 1078 = 22 × r²

⇒ r² = 1078 ÷ 22 = 49

⇒ Radius (r) = 7 cm

⇒ Slant height (l) = √(7² + 21²) = √(49 + 441) = √490 = 7√10 cm

⇒ TSA = πr² + πrl = πr(r + l)

⇒ TSA = (22/7) × 7 × (7 + 7√10)

⇒ TSA = 22 × 7(1 + √10) = 154(1 + √10) cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 154(1 + √10) cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Cone

The relationship between height (h), radius (r), and slant height (l) is given by Pythagoras theorem: l = √(r² + h²).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The lateral surface area or CSA of a right circular cone is given by the formula πrl.

Volume of a Cone

The volume of a cone is exactly one-third of the volume of a cylinder with the same base and height: V = (1/3)πr²h.</p

questions.question:
A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 21 g/cm³. Its internal and external radii are 8 cm and 9 cm, respectively. What is the weight (in kg) of the shell?

( {Use} pi = (22)/(7), {Density} = frac{{Mass}}{{Volume}} )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of metal = 4/3 × π × (R³ − r³)

Mass = Volume × Density = 4/3 × 22/7 × (9³ − 8³) × 21

Mass = 4/3 × 22/7 × (729 − 512) × 21 = 88 × 217 = 19096 g

Weight in kg = 19096 ÷ 1000 = 19.096 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 19.096 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** External radius (R) = 9 cm, Internal radius (r) = 8 cm, Density = 21 g/cm³

**Formula Used:** Volume of hollow sphere = 4/3 × π × (R³ − r³); Mass = Density × Volume

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9908f41a30cfeab5ded5bf931cc25250f8ed6fa998530122b2aae4754c6afc28.png] 

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 22/7 × (9³ − 8³)

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 22/7 × (729 − 512) = 4/3 × 22/7 × 217

⇒ Volume = 88/21 × 217 cm³

⇒ Mass = Density × Volume = 21 × (88/21 × 217)

⇒ Mass = 88 × 217 = 19096 g

⇒ Weight in kg = 19096 / 1000 = 19.096 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 19.096 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Hollow Sphere Properties

The volume of the material is the difference between external and internal volumes: V = 4/3π(R³−r³).

Density-Mass Relation

Mass is the product of Volume and Density. Unit conversion: 1 kg = 1000 g.

Total Surface Area of Hollow Sphere

The sum of inner and outer surface areas: TSA = 4πR² + 4πr² = 4π(R²+r²).</p

questions.question: Calculate the area of the triangle whose sides are 8 cm, 9 cm and 13 cm. (Rounded up to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify sides: **a = 8**, **b = 9**, **c = 13**.

Semi-perimeter **s = (8 + 9 + 13) ÷ 2 = 15 cm**.

Area = √[15 × (15 − 8) × (15 − 9) × (15 − 13)]

Area = √[15 × 7 × 6 × 2] = √1260 ≈ **35.50 cm²**.

**∴ The correct answer is 35.50 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the **triangle**: **a = 8 cm**, **b = 9 cm**, **c = 13 cm**.

**Formula Used:**

**Heron's Formula**: Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)]

Where **s** is the **semi-perimeter**: s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfc30231aa37dc43ac463ceaceb8d53f4cdc8b8e9fc991f0fae1826cc610645a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ s = (8 + 9 + 13) ÷ 2

⇒ s = 30 ÷ 2 = **15 cm**

⇒ Area = √[15 × (15 − 8) × (15 − 9) × (15 − 13)]

⇒ Area = √[15 × 7 × 6 × 2]

⇒ Area = √[1260]

⇒ Area ≈ **35.496 cm²**

⇒ Rounding to two decimal places, we get **35.50 cm²**.

**∴ The correct answer is 35.50 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

Used to find the area of any **triangle** when the lengths of all three sides are known. Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)].

Right-Angled Triangle Area

If the triangle is **right-angled**, the area can be simply calculated as 1/2 × **base** × **height**.

Equilateral Triangle Area

For a triangle with all equal sides **a**, Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × **a²**.</p

questions.question: The volume (in m³) of a cube, each of whose edges is 25 m, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **cube** with edge **a**, the **Volume** = **a³**.

Given **edge (a)** = 25 m.

Volume = 25 × 25 × 25 = 625 × 25 = 15,625 m³.

**∴ The correct answer is 15,625 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Edge of the cube (a)** = 25 m

**Formula Used:**

**Volume of a Cube** = (Edge)³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/141f86a8909bbed02aefc09b2ae6a77b009dd72fa53e3b15fce0c78555248148.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = 25 m × 25 m × 25 m

⇒ Volume = 625 × 25 m³

⇒ Volume = 15,625 m³

**∴ The correct answer is 15,625 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cube

The total area of all six faces is given by 6 × a².

Lateral Surface Area of Cube

The area of the four side faces is given by 4 × a².

Diagonal of a Cube

The longest distance between two opposite corners is √3 × a.</p

questions.question: Calculate the volume of the cube having a total surface area of 216 cm²
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **cube**, if **TSA** = 6a² and **Volume** = a³.

When TSA = 216, then 6a² = 216 ⇒ a² = 36 ⇒ a = 6 cm.

Volume = 6³ = 216 cm³.

Note: For a cube, if TSA is 216, the numerical value of volume is also 216.

**∴ The correct answer is 216 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Total Surface Area (TSA)** of the cube = 216 cm².

**Formula Used:**

1) Total Surface Area of cube = 6 × (side)²

2) Volume of cube = (side)³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdbbae43678637c0ffb82126e7b4f4e08d36fb0c544946a3ef06a4fce57a06a8.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 6 × a² = 216

⇒ a² = 216 ÷ 6

⇒ a² = 36

⇒ a = √36

⇒ a = 6 cm

⇒ Volume = a³ = 6 × 6 × 6

⇒ Volume = 216 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 216 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of the four vertical faces of the cube, calculated as 4 × a².

Diagonal of a Cube

The longest rod that can be placed inside a cube of side 'a' is a√3.

Relation between TSA and Volume

Numerically, TSA = Volume only when the side of the cube is exactly 6 units.</p

questions.question: Find the volume (in cm³) of a hemispherical cap having a radius of 24 cm.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of **hemisphere** = (2/3)πr³

Substitute **radius (r) = 24 cm** directly into the formula.

Volume = (2/3) × π × 24 × 24 × 24 = 2 × π × 8 × 24 × 24

Volume = 16 × 576 × π = 9216π

**∴ The correct answer is 9216π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) of the **hemispherical cap** = 24 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a **hemisphere** = (2/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/336a8e5f8f4a2c0a87093ddbcbf0a693d8688c9c575f211e0beca3f288923868.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = (2/3) × π × (24)³

⇒ Volume = (2/3) × π × 13824

⇒ Volume = 2 × π × 4608

⇒ Volume = 9216π

**∴ The correct answer is 9216π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Hemisphere

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the flat base area: **TSA = 3πr²**.

Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere

The area of the outer curved part only: **CSA = 2πr²**.

Volume of a Sphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a full sphere: **Volume of Sphere = (4/3)πr³**.</p

questions.question: A rectangular tin sheet is 32 cm long and 14 cm wide. It is rolled along its length to form a cylinder, with opposite edges just touching each other. Find the volume (in cm³) of the cylinder.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a **rectangular sheet** is rolled along its **length**, the **length** becomes the **circumference** (2πr) and the **width** becomes the **height** (h).

Circumference 2πr = 32 ⇒ r = 16/π

Volume V = πr²h = π × (16/π)² × 14

V = π × (256/π²) × 14 = (256 × 14)/π = 3584/π

**∴ The correct answer is 3584/π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length** of sheet (L) = 32 cm

**Width** of sheet (W) = 14 cm

**Formula Used:**

**Circumference** of circle = 2πr

**Volume** of cylinder = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5c278d6752584d6569904a9f247f298599fbffbbd871ce2d232933d707333ea.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ When rolled along the length, **Circumference** = 32 cm

⇒ 2 × π × r = 32

⇒ r = 32 / (2π) = 16/π cm

⇒ **Height** of the cylinder (h) = Width of the sheet = 14 cm

⇒ **Volume** (V) = π × r² × h

⇒ V = π × (16/π)² × 14

⇒ V = π × (256 / π²) × 14

⇒ V = (256 × 14) / π

⇒ V = 3584/π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 3584/π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Rolling (Along Width)

If the sheet is rolled along its width, the **width** becomes the **circumference** (2πr = W) and the **length** becomes the **height** (h = L).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The CSA of the resulting cylinder is always equal to the **Area of the Rectangular Sheet** (L × W), which is 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The TSA of a solid cylinder includes the top and bottom circles: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r).</p

questions.question: A cylinder is made by rolling a rectangular paper along its breadth. Find the curved surface area of the cylinder, if the length and breadth of the rectangle are 12 m and 7.48 m, respectively. (Use π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a **rectangular paper** is rolled into a **cylinder**, its **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** is exactly equal to the **Area of the Rectangle**.

Area of Rectangle = **Length × Breadth**

Area = 12 m × 7.48 m = 89.76 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 89.76 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length** of rectangular paper (L) = 12 m

**Breadth** of rectangular paper (B) = 7.48 m

The paper is rolled along its **breadth** to form a **cylinder**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b798c71161547ce16410da5c9ba83eec8c3d536304d2fd5f4c37cdae081d8de.png] 

**Formula Used:**

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** of cylinder = 2 × π × r × h

When rolled along the **breadth**:

⇒ **Height** (h) of cylinder = **Length** of rectangle = 12 m

⇒ **Circumference** (2πr) of base = **Breadth** of rectangle = 7.48 m

**Calculations:**

⇒ CSA = (2πr) × h

⇒ CSA = 7.48 × 12

⇒ CSA = 89.76 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 89.76 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rolling along Length vs Breadth

If rolled along **Length**, h = Breadth and 2πr = Length. If rolled along **Breadth**, h = Length and 2πr = Breadth. In both cases, **CSA** remains the **Area** of the paper.

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

**TSA** = 2πr(h + r). This includes the **CSA** plus the areas of the two circular **bases** (2 × πr²).

Volume of Cylinder

**Volume** = πr²h. It measures the total capacity or **space** occupied by the 3D cylinder.</p

questions.question: The surface area of a sphere is 4π cm². The volume of the sphere is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area = 4πr² = 4π ⇒ r² = 1 ⇒ r = 1 cm.

Volume = (4/3)πr³ = (4/3)π(1)³ = 4π/3 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 4π/3 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Surface area** of the **sphere** = 4π cm².

**Formula used:** **Surface area** = 4πr²; **Volume** = (4/3)πr³.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22e98ea39ea6c5aa5c0340d25dd4bb15df39e72b4ba0ccb7ae5cf63e3f82e3b2.png] 

⇒ 4πr² = 4π

⇒ r² = 1

⇒ **Radius (r)** = 1 cm

⇒ **Volume** = (4/3) × π × (1)³

⇒ **Volume** = 4π/3 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 4π/3 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Hemisphere formulas

For a **hemisphere** of radius r, **Curved Surface Area** = 2πr² and **Total Surface Area** = 3πr².

Volume of Hemisphere

The **volume** of a **hemisphere** is exactly half of a sphere: V = (2/3)πr³.

Ratio of SA to Volume

For any **sphere**, the ratio of its **Surface Area** to its **Volume** is 3/r.</p

questions.question:
A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 11 g/cm³. Its internal and external radii are 3 cm and 6 cm, respectively. What is the weight (in kg) of the shell?

( {Use } pi = (22)/(7), { Density } = frac{{Mass}}{{Volume}} )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of **hollow shell** = 4/3 × π × (R³ − r³)

V = 4/3 × 22/7 × (6³ − 3³) = 4/3 × 22/7 × (216 − 27) = 4/3 × 22/7 × 189

V = 4 × 22 × 9 = 792 cm³

Mass = Volume × Density = 792 × 11 = 8712 g = 8.712 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 8.712 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Internal radius (r) = 3 cm, External radius (R) = 6 cm, Density = 11 g/cm³

**Formula Used:** Volume (V) = 4/3 π(R³ − r³); Mass = Density × Volume

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa6cf975c7bea9be4b6e0583087e0980f44259ca69fb7a1915eb9dd65a069de8.png] 

⇒ Volume of metal = 4/3 × 22/7 × (6³ − 3³)

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 22/7 × (216 − 27)

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 22/7 × 189

⇒ Volume = 4 × 22 × 9 = 792 cm³

⇒ Weight in grams = 792 × 11 = 8712 g

⇒ Weight in kg = 8712 ÷ 1000 = 8.712 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 8.712 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Sphere

The volume of a solid sphere is given by V = 4/3 πr³, where r is the radius.

Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is 4πr². For a hollow shell, the total surface area is 4πR² + 4πr².

Density Conversion

To convert weight from grams to kilograms, divide the value by 1000 (1 kg = 1000 g).</p

questions.question: A sphere with a radius of 53 cm is melted to form a cone with the same radius at its base. Find the height (in cm) of the cone.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a **sphere** is melted into a **cone** with the same **radius (r)**, their volumes are equated.

4/3 × π × r³ = 1/3 × π × r² × h

4 × r = h

h = 4 × 53 = 212 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 212 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of **Sphere** (r) = 53 cm

Radius of **Base of Cone** (r) = 53 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Sphere = 4/3 × π × r³

Volume of Cone = 1/3 × π × r² × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1ad1a184345f5c22a49558cb3d73446992073609254a5e1b0c385eda9914f0f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of Sphere = Volume of Cone

⇒ 4/3 × π × (53)³ = 1/3 × π × (53)² × h

⇒ 4 × 53 = h

⇒ h = 212 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 212 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is given by the formula 4πr².

Slant Height of a Cone

The slant height (l) of a cone is calculated using the Pythagorean theorem: l = √(r² + h²).

Melting and Recasting Rule

In all 3D mensuration problems involving melting and recasting, the volume of the original shape always remains equal to the total volume of the new shapes formed.</p

questions.question: A conical vessel has base radius 6 cm and height 20 cm. Water is poured into the vessel until it is 3/4 full. Find the volume (in cm³) of water in the vessel.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Volume of full **conical vessel** = (1/3) × π × r² × h

Volume = (1/3) × π × 6² × 20 = (1/3) × π × 36 × 20 = 12 × 20 × π = 240π cm³

Volume of water = (3/4) × Total Volume = (3/4) × 240π

Volume of water = 3 × 60π = 180π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 180π cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Base radius** (r) = 6 cm

**Height** (h) = 20 cm

**Water level** = 3/4 full

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b5bd456ad2756908c805671f437173dc299ebe0d00062d2203e56aecfdcfbff.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Cone (V) = (1/3)πr²h

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total capacity of vessel = (1/3) × π × (6)² × 20

⇒ Total capacity = (1/3) × π × 36 × 20

⇒ Total capacity = 12 × 20 × π = 240π cm³

⇒ Volume of water poured = 3/4 × Total capacity

⇒ Volume of water = (3/4) × 240π

⇒ Volume of water = 3 × 60π = 180π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 180π cm³.**

questions.question: 731 metallic cubes with a side length of 3.6 cm are available to be melted and formed into a machine part consisting of two solid cones with a base radius of 5.4 cm, joined at their bases. Number of **cubes used** = 2563.9104 ÷ 46.656 = 55

**Surplus cubes** = 731 − 55 = 676

**∴ The correct answer is 676 cubes.**

**Given:** Total cubes = 731, **Side** (a) = 3.6 cm, **Radius** (r) = 5.4 cm, **Heights** (h₁, h₂) = 49 cm, 35 cm, π = 3.14

**Formula Used:** Volume of cube = a³; Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92007154812e1ebf7b7a3fad674decb23c53f3434faf6ade95de1e21ffbd49a0.png] 

⇒ Volume of 1 **cube** = 3.6 × 3.6 × 3.6 = 46.656 cm³

⇒ Total volume of **machine part** = (1/3) × π × r² × h₁ + (1/3) × π × r² × h₂

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × 3.14 × (5.4)² × (49 + 35)

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × 3.14 × 29.16 × 84

⇒ Volume = 3.14 × 29.16 × 28 = 2563.9104 cm³

⇒ Number of **cubes used** (n) = Total Volume ÷ Volume of 1 cube

⇒ n = 2563.9104 ÷ 46.656 = 55

⇒ **Surplus cubes** = Total cubes − Cubes used = 731 − 55 = 676

**∴ The correct answer is 676 cubes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Solid Figures

For a **cone**, Volume = (1/3)πr²h. For a **cube**, Volume = a³. When melting and recasting, the total volume remains constant.

Surplus Calculation

Surplus = Total Available Units − Units Utilized. Utilized units must be an integer if discrete items (like cubes) are used.</p

questions.question: The shorter side of a rectangle is 24 cm less than the longer side. The numerical value of its area is equal to 8 times the numerical value of its perimeter. What is the length (in cm) of its longer side?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **longer side** be L and **shorter side** be (L − 24).

Given: Area = 8 × Perimeter ⇒ L(L − 24) = 8 × 2[L + (L − 24)].

L(L − 24) = 16(2L − 24) ⇒ L² − 24L = 32L − 384.

L² − 56L + 384 = 0 ⇒ (L − 48)(L − 8) = 0.

Since side (L − 24) must be positive, L > 24, so L = 48.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Difference between **longer side (L)** and **shorter side (B)** = 24 cm. Area = 8 × Perimeter.

**Formula Used:** Area of rectangle = **L × B**; Perimeter of rectangle = **2(L + B)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48eb247b7b1da0635a9ad76cbae82c260909e9ccf3ac4871e08741c0d5dcf990.png] 

⇒ Let L = x, then B = x − 24.

⇒ Area = x(x − 24).

⇒ Perimeter = 2(x + x − 24) = 2(2x − 24) = 4x − 48.

⇒ According to question: x(x − 24) = 8(4x − 48).

⇒ x² − 24x = 32x − 384.

⇒ x² − 56x + 384 = 0.

⇒ x² − 48x − 8x + 384 = 0.

⇒ x(x − 48) − 8(x − 48) = 0.

⇒ (x − 48)(x − 8) = 0.

⇒ x = 48 or x = 8.

⇒ Since B = x − 24, x cannot be 8 (else B would be negative).

⇒ Longer side L = 48 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rectangle

A rectangle is a quadrilateral with four right angles. Opposite sides are equal and parallel. The **diagonal** length is given by √(L² + B²).

Quadratic Roots

For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots is −b/a and product of roots is c/a. In x² − 56x + 384 = 0, 48 × 8 = 384 and 48 + 8 = 56.</p

questions.question: The length of a rectangular plot is (x² + xy + y²) m and its breadth is (x2 - 5xy - y2) m. Find its perimeter, when x = 1 and y = - 1.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put the values of **x = 1** and **y = −1** directly into the expressions for length (L) and breadth (B).

L = 1² + 1(−1) + (−1)² = 1 − 1 + 1 = 1 m.

B = 1² − 5(1)(−1) − (−1)² = 1 + 5 − 1 = 5 m.

Perimeter = 2(L + B) = 2(1 + 5) = 2 × 6 = 12 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71bbe0a0a20fef1ea7d7ded70f9668622296d27c79770cab70672adc0a2c9f13.png] 

**Given:**

Length (L) = x² + xy + y²

Breadth (B) = x² − 5xy − y²

Values: **x = 1**, **y = −1**

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of Rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

**Calculations:**

⇒ L = (1)² + (1)(−1) + (−1)²

⇒ L = 1 − 1 + 1 = 1 m

⇒ B = (1)² − 5(1)(−1) − (−1)²

⇒ B = 1 + 5 − 1 = 5 m

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (1 + 5)

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × 6 = 12 m

**∴ The correct answer is 12 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Rectangle

The total space occupied by the rectangle, calculated as Area = Length × Breadth.

Diagonal of Rectangle

The distance between opposite corners, given by d = √(L² + B²).

Algebraic Substitution

Always substitute negative values within parentheses to ensure correct sign application (e.g., (−1)² = 1).</p

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cylinder is half of its total surface area. If its height is 195 cm, then find its diameter (in cm).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the given condition, **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 1/2 × **Total Surface Area (TSA)**.

For a **cylinder**, this specific condition (CSA = TSA/2) always implies that the **radius (r)** is equal to the **height (h)**.

Given **height (h)** = 195 cm ⇒ **radius (r)** = 195 cm.

**Diameter (d)** = 2 × r = 2 × 195 = 390 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 390 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Height (h)** = 195 cm and **CSA** = 1/2 × **TSA**.

**Formula Used:** CSA = 2πrh | TSA = 2πr(h + r)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8068b5439d22a208bbedb031127497d7c8f5bcbca66e1b5073ddfee3103b7939.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2πrh = 1/2 × [2πr(h + r)]

⇒ 2πrh = πr(h + r)

⇒ 2h = h + r

⇒ r = h

⇒ Since h = 195 cm, r = 195 cm.

⇒ **Diameter (d)** = 2 × r = 2 × 195 = 390 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 390 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cylinder

The amount of space occupied is given by V = πr²h.

CSA and TSA Relationship

TSA is always equal to CSA + 2 × Area of circular bases, i.e., TSA = 2πrh + 2πr².

Hollow Cylinder

For a cylinder with internal radius r and external radius R, Volume = π(R² − r²)h.</p

questions.question: The shorter side of a rectangle is 15 cm less than the longer side. The numerical value of its area is equal to 5 times the numerical value of its perimeter. What is the length (in cm) of its longer side?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **longer side** be L and **shorter side** be (L − 15).

Area = 5 × Perimeter ⇒ L(L − 15) = 5 × 2[L + (L − 15)]

L² − 15L = 10(2L − 15) ⇒ L² − 15L = 20L − 150

L² − 35L + 150 = 0 ⇒ (L − 30)(L − 5) = 0

Since L > 15 (as shorter side = L − 15), L must be 30.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let **longer side** (length) = x cm

Then **shorter side** (breadth) = (x − 15) cm

**Formula Used:**

**Area of Rectangle** = length × breadth

**Perimeter of Rectangle** = 2(length + breadth)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1481fe1d77f4f43242d4a4b1b3fa402f32c53e73e46a5935cee965d2e6de5ae0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = x(x − 15)

⇒ Perimeter = 2[x + (x − 15)] = 2(2x − 15) = 4x − 30

⇒ According to question: x(x − 15) = 5 × (4x − 30)

⇒ x² − 15x = 20x − 150

⇒ x² − 35x + 150 = 0

⇒ x² − 30x − 5x + 150 = 0

⇒ x(x − 30) − 5(x − 30) = 0

⇒ (x − 30)(x − 5) = 0

⇒ x = 30 or x = 5

⇒ If x = 5, then shorter side = 5 − 15 = −10 (Not possible as length cannot be negative).

⇒ ∴ x = 30 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 30 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Diagonal of Rectangle

The diagonal d of a rectangle with sides l and b is given by d = √(l² + b²).

Quadratic Roots Property

For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots is −b/a and product of roots is c/a.

Relationship between Area and Perimeter

For a square of side a, Area = a² and Perimeter = 4a. If Area = Perimeter, then a = 4 units.</p

questions.question:
The diameter of the base and slant height of a right circular cone are 30 cm and 113 cm, respectively. Find the volume (in cm³) of the given cone.

(Use π=(22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Radius (r)** = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm.

**Height (h)** = √(113² − 15²) = √(12769 − 225) = √12544 = 112 cm.

**Volume** = (1/3) × (22/7) × 15 × 15 × 112.

**Volume** = 22 × 5 × 15 × 16 = 26,400 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 26,400 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Diameter** = 30 cm, **Slant height (l)** = 113 cm.

**Formula Used:** Radius (r) = Diameter/2 | l² = r² + h² | Volume = (1/3)πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e754e4d9d1c99308074608d53b5a00de1d975bcb67c7e3741a49cbb64674b00f.png] 

⇒ Radius (r) = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm

⇒ h² = l² − r² = 113² − 15²

⇒ h² = (113 − 15)(113 + 15) = 98 × 128 = 12544

⇒ h = √12544 = 112 cm

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 15 × 15 × 112

⇒ Volume = 22 × 5 × 15 × 16 = 26,400 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 26,400 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Cone

The relationship between height (h), radius (r), and slant height (l) is given by the Pythagorean theorem: l = √(r² + h²).

Surface Area of Cone

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = πrl and Total Surface Area (TSA) = πr(l + r).

Volume Comparison

The volume of a cone is exactly one-third the volume of a cylinder with the same radius and height (V = 1/3 πr²h).</p

questions.question: In a circle of radius 10.5 cm, if the angle of a sector is (2pi)/(3), then the perimeter of the sector is (in cm): (Take pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Perimeter of sector** = **Length of arc** + 2 × **Radius**

Angle θ = 2π/3 radians, which is equivalent to 120°.

Arc length = (120/360) × 2 × (22/7) × 10.5 = 22 cm.

Perimeter = 22 + 2 × 10.5 = 22 + 21 = 43 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 43 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = **10.5 cm**

Sector Angle (θ) = **2π/3 radians**

**Formula Used:**

Length of arc (l) = r × θ (where θ is in radians)

Perimeter of sector = **l + 2r**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/186c085dc65f850c8d19d4969f3ac349802add53f31a5f76f0e4689ff357652a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Length of arc (l) = 10.5 × (2 × 22 / (7 × 3))

⇒ l = 10.5 × (44 / 21)

⇒ l = 0.5 × 44 = 22 cm

⇒ Perimeter of sector = 22 + 2 × 10.5

⇒ Perimeter = 22 + 21 = 43 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 43 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Sector

The area is given by (1/2) × r² × θ (radians) or (θ/360) × πr² (degrees).

Arc Length Formula

Length l = rθ when θ is in radians; l = (θ/360) × 2πr when θ is in degrees.

Radian to Degree Conversion

To convert radians to degrees, multiply by 180/π. Here, (2π/3) × (180/π) = 120°.</p

questions.question: Find the circumference (in m) of the largest circle that can be inscribed in a rectangle whose dimensions are given as 114 m and 63 m. (Take pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **diameter** of the **largest inscribed circle** in a rectangle is always equal to the **shorter side** of the rectangle.

Diameter (d) = 63 m

Circumference = πd = (22/7) × 63 = 22 × 9 = 198 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 198 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Length** (L) = 114 m, **Breadth** (B) = 63 m.

**Formula Used:** Diameter (d) of the largest inscribed circle = Breadth (B) of the rectangle; Circumference = π × d.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65ecd507f0fa6d1db65a79a8ae5ec8d2cbe2d28328c948a6f02e0338159969e0.png] 

⇒ Diameter of the circle (d) = 63 m

⇒ Radius (r) = d/2 = 63/2 = 31.5 m

⇒ Circumference = 2 × π × r = π × d

⇒ Circumference = (22/7) × 63

⇒ Circumference = 22 × 9

⇒ Circumference = 198 m

**∴ The correct answer is 198 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inscribed Circle in Square

For a **square** of side 'a', the diameter of the **inscribed circle** is exactly equal to the side 'a'. Area = πa²/4.

Circumscribed Circle

The diameter of a circle **circumscribing** a rectangle is equal to the **diagonal** of the rectangle, calculated as √(L² + B²).

Circle Properties

Area of circle = πr². The **circumference** is the total boundary length, also known as the **perimeter** of the circle.</p

questions.question: A cylindrical rod has an curved surface area of 4,900 cm² . If the length of the rod is 97 cm, then the radius (in cm) of the rod, correct to two places of decimal, is: (Take pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r × h

4900 = 2 × (22/7) × r × 97

r = (4900 × 7) ÷ (2 × 22 × 97) ≈ 34300 ÷ 4268

r ≈ 8.0365...

**∴ The correct answer is 8.04 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** of the **cylindrical rod** = 4,900 cm²

**Length (Height)** of the rod (h) = 97 cm

Value of π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

CSA of a cylinder = 2πrh

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acfc20d87e7f5a336398acfe9ddd054202895a25421605a0bc0fc46471511f2a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4900 = 2 × (22/7) × r × 97

⇒ 4900 × 7 = 44 × 97 × r

⇒ 34300 = 4268 × r

⇒ r = 34300 ÷ 4268

⇒ r = 8.03655...

⇒ r ≈ 8.04 cm (rounded to two decimal places)

**∴ The correct answer is 8.04 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

The sum of curved surface area and the area of two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Cylinder

The capacity of the cylindrical rod: Volume = πr²h.

Base Area

The area of the circular cross-section of the rod: Area = πr².</p
